long: The Settlers II is a real-time strategy and building game where players grow a settlement by managing intricate supply chains of resources and goods carried along road networks. Players expand territory, raise armies, and conquer rivals across campaign and free-play maps. This edition runs on the open-source Return to the Roots engine, which adds widescreen support and network multiplayer.
name: The Settlers II Gold
short: The Settlers II Gold (via Return to the Roots)
